pr_body:

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This ensures we have Network stats for containerd on Windows by querying for the stats were directly.  By going to network component directly we also minimize the calls the to listing containers (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/104285)

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

```release-note
Add support for Windows Network stats in Containerd
```

Although, it is slightly awkward due to build constraints in hcsshim (can't import the project when GOOS=linux) I added unit tests to the solution to help make sure I got the logic correct since it was a bit convoluted. You can follow the commits to see the unit tests working against existing solution, then the updates to make the new solution work.  

If preferred I can drop out the unit tests since it adds the awkward interface to the provider but they were helpful to aid in the refactoring.

I also added custom logging (now removed) to verify that the data was the same when the same pods where deployed on the system. The result at the point where it is being used is the same minus small differences in actually network traffic:

Before:
```

kubelet.exe.INFO:2984:I1101 23:05:09.070791    9548 cri_stats_provider.go:437] "jjs adding stats" name="Ethernet" in=3290739 out=1109478
```

After:
```

kubelet.exe.INFO:124:I1103 00:15:43.349878    9348 cri_stats_provider.go:438] "jjs adding stats" name="fd3971a07bc0ad5a361673469eeaa7e736cfd2cc4a5d799aa4eff0728ba166b5_flannel.4096" in=6781898 out=4690117
```

I added e2e test to make sure these stats are returned so they aren't dropped in the future as well.

Finally I collected results against the kubelet and vmcompute while running the modified e2e test to verify cpu went down when removing the duplicated calls as identified in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/104285. And you can see a difference (the right half is when the test was run)

Thank you @jsturtevant for adding this. I wanted to point out the [KEP](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/2371-cri-pod-container-stats) that me and @haircommander are working on to move all of the stats from pod / container stats from the kubelet to the underlying container runtime (this includes network stats). So long term, it would be great to get these stats implemented directly in containerd CRI API (and get support on windows!). Happy to chat more about this offline, will ping you on slack :)
